zh.title: C4 Container 與四層導覽
zh.objective: 以 Container 描述可執行單位及資料儲存。
zh.practice: 標示瀏覽器、應用程序、資料儲存與通訊；導覽四個 C4 層級。
zh.assessment: 能區分 Container 與程序內元件，不將 C4 Container 等同 Docker。

en.title: C4 Containers and the Four Levels
en.objective: Describe executable units and data stores with a container diagram.
en.practice: Show the browser, application process, storage and communication, then locate the four C4 levels.
en.assessment: Distinguish containers from in-process components and from Docker containers.
